type: Local review, not ratified canonical art
brief: Retain detailed graph at phone/tablet sizes; dusk chrome sphere; varied-width rainbow neon street-art flow; moderate hover; softer shadow; foreground arc; graph logo stamped into sphere.

iterations.prompt:
Create the next targeted edit of this SalvorLabs hero photograph. Image 1 is the scene/edit target. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for glossy luminous rainbow neon material and color transitions. Do not reproduce any Apple/Finder icons, faces, symbols, lettering, or black poster layout from image 2.

PRESERVE: the wide 1672x941 composition, single perfect chrome sphere close to camera, dark blue dusk, very low thin warm desert horizon, endless cracked ground, shallow reflective pool, physically reflected environment. Keep the central sphere a polished MIRROR surface. This is still the same cinematic desert world.

CRITICAL LEVITATION GEOMETRY:
The sphere represents a roughly 3.5-foot-diameter object hovering TWO FEET above the ground. Its bottom must have a conspicuous EMPTY AIR GAP to the ground below, about 55-65% of its own diameter. It cannot touch the ground, reflection, glowing base, platform, or any support.
Composition guide: sphere center x=836,y=435, radius approximately165 pixels, so the sphere bottom is around y=600. The ground shadow and white light pool directly beneath it belong around y=790, leaving about190px of visibly empty air. You MUST show that large empty air gap. The ground is behind and below the floating object, not a mound rising up to it. The water reflection is clearly detached below the gap, not another sphere touching it. No glowing UFO disc or platform. Use a soft dark grounded shadow surrounded by a localized WHITE pool of light on the existing cracked ground and water.

NEON ART DIRECTION:
Completely replace the regular blue orbital rings with much more ACTIVE, ASYMMETRIC, flowing rainbow neon. Think edgy street-culture light painting or gestural neon graffiti in physical 3D space: confident calligraphic sweeps, fast S-curves, compact curls, diagonal counter-strokes, short luminous dashes and a few very fine trailing filaments. No readable graffiti letters. Avoid repeated ellipses, closed rings, uniform coils, a regular halo or Saturn orbits.
Use the reference's glassy luminous tube quality with smooth vivid gradients through cyan, electric blue, violet, hot pink, coral, orange, gold and a touch of acid green. Vary width strongly along and BETWEEN strokes: thin hairline trails, swelling rounded thick strokes, tapering ends, bright white-hot highlights and dimmer saturated tails. Undulate and modulate the intensity and apparent activity around the object, with a few energetic clusters and quieter gaps. It should feel alive and spontaneous, not uniform. Keep the sphere's center visually legible.
The flow must curve through real depth, passing in front and behind the sphere with correct occlusion. The chrome sphere MUST visibly carry the surrounding RAINBOW LIGHT reflected and distorted across its surface, and the ground/water MUST reflect the same colors in their corresponding locations. No actual lightning, jagged forks, branching electric bolts, star-shaped sparks or explosions.

LIGHT / WEBSITE SPACE:
Dark navy dusk; not daytime. Keep upper quarter calm and mostly dark for white real HTML text. Keep rainbow activity in the central/lower area around the sphere. Ground white glow stays localized and bright directly below the hovering sphere; do not whiten the entire foreground or sky.

Do not generate a logo or words in this pass. Leave the chrome center ready for a precise deterministic graph-logo imprint that will be added from the exact approved artwork in the web composition. No text, no logos, no extra objects, no people. High-end photographic chrome and grounded dramatic light, with the irreverent energy of street art rather than corporate orbital graphics.

HEIGHT CORRECTION ONLY. Keep this rainbow-neon/chrome/desert photograph and its existing color, flowing modulated neon strokes, lighting and camera.

MOVE THE ACTUAL CHROME SPHERE UPWARD by roughly HALF ITS DIAMETER (about 180 pixels in this 1672x941 frame). Do not leave it hovering only inches above the ground. It must hover TWO FEET in empty air. The sphere is about3.5 feet across, so the empty gap beneath the ball must be more than HALF of the ball's diameter.

The actual sphere currently ends around y=650. Move its lowest point to about y=470. LEAVE the ground shadow and white ground light down near y=690. Thus around220 pixels of clearly visible EMPTY AIR separate the ball from the ground below. Raise the surrounding rainbow neon activity with the sphere, keeping all smooth varied-width colors and active gestures, but preserve generous separation between the luminous object and ground light.

The ground stays flat, the pool stays in place. NO pedestal, NO platform, NO glowing support disc touching the ball. Make the water reflection belong to the elevated object, separated well below it. Maintain rainbow light reflected in the chrome. Keep the single sphere close to camera at the same large size; do not shrink it. No letters, no emblem, no text.

Refine this accepted SalvorLabs hero photograph with ONLY TWO changes. Preserve the levitating chrome sphere's current height, large clear air gap, size and placement; rainbow graffiti-like flowing neon with modulated width; all existing environment/light reflections; deep dusk; cracked desert; and water reflection. Do not lower or move the sphere. Do not turn flowing neon into lightning.

1. The small dark oval ground shadow below the hovering sphere is too BLACK. Soften and lighten it substantially into a subtle translucent gray-violet shadow, with a broad soft penumbra, allowing the white reflected glow and ground texture to remain visible through it. It must not resemble a black hole or glowing portal. Keep the localized WHITE ground glow under the floating sphere.

2. Add ONE additional flowing rainbow color arc in the FOREGROUND, closer to the camera than the sphere. Make it an asymmetrical gestural tapered light-painted stroke across part of the lower-left/lower-middle scene, a little thicker and softer in focus than the farther trails, transitioning through gold/orange into pink and cyan/green. It should establish depth in front of the pool, not become another regular orbital ring. Make its colored light reflect naturally on the nearby wet ground. Do not cover the entire ground with neon. Preserve the existing active smooth color strokes around the sphere.

Do not add or generate a logo in the photo itself: the exact supplied graph logo will be deterministically engraved into the center in the immediately following web composition. No text, no labels, no extra objects. Keep the wide 1672x941 composition and photo realism.

Edit IMAGE 1, the rainbow-neon desert photograph. IMAGE 2 is the actual SalvorLabs brain/knowledge-graph logo to STAMP INTO THE METAL FRONT of the sphere. Make this a finished scene WITH THE LOGO VISIBLE, not a blank sphere or a placeholder.

THREE REQUIRED CORRECTIONS:
1. LOWER the current sphere and surrounding neon cluster by about75 pixels. Preserve its diameter, close camera and rainbow flowing strokes. Its bottom should end near y=580-590, with the ground light/shadow still down near y=690. Keep a clear modest hover gap of roughly100 pixels, not the previous180-200px gap and not almost touching the ground.
2. Replace the small very dark ground-shadow oval with a BROADER, MUCH SOFTER, LIGHTER realistic penumbra. Roughly280-320px wide with feathered edges, translucent gray-violet, filled by the rainbow/white reflected illumination. No black hole, no hard dark disk, no portal. The shadow and water reflection must be physically coherent with this middle hovering height.
3. MOST IMPORTANT: Press the supplied IMAGE 2 logo into the exact front-center of the chrome sphere as a visible INSET STAMP / SHALLOW ENGRAVING. Use the actual supplied split brain-shaped knowledge graph, including its central seam, outside contours, connected graph lines and nodes; do not invent another brain or monogram. Center it on the sphere's face at approximately x=835,y=405. Its diameter should be about150px, around40% of the sphere diameter, large enough to be clearly recognized. Shallow RECESSED metal grooves with dark inner edges and slim bright bevels, following the sphere curvature and surrounding colored light. It must look physically stamped into reflective chrome. No floating projection, no hologram, no raised badge, no sticker, no printed black square/background. The field between grooves remains reflective sphere metal. Preserve the supplied logo's recognizable proportions and topology. The inset logo should be plainly visible in this render.

Also retain a single additional rainbow arc in the foreground, with varied tapered stroke width, so the flow has depth toward the camera. Keep the rainbow light's reflections in the chrome and wet ground; show the faint mirrored logo in the water if visible.

Maintain the existing photographic dusk/desert composition, beautiful active smooth rainbow light-painting character and white ground glow. No lightning, no text, no added logo elsewhere, no redesign of the scene. Wide 1672x941 image.

notes: Header keeps exact canonical logo pixels. The photograph contains an ImageGen interpretation of the supplied logo as a metal stamp; this does not replace canonical artwork. All earlier scenes and the original page remain preserved.
